title: LinkedIn Company Details Scraper (No Cookies)
description: Scrape LinkedIn company details without requiring cookies. Provide company URLs directly or search by company name.

companyUrls.title: Company LinkedIn URLs
companyUrls.description: List of LinkedIn company page URLs to scrape. Example: https://www.linkedin.com/company/google

companyNames.title: Company Names (to search)
companyNames.description: Search LinkedIn for companies by name. Note: LinkedIn search results can be inaccurate. Actor will scrape https://www.linkedin.com/search/results/companies/?keywords=example

fileName.title: File Name
fileName.description: Tag name for this run. Used to identify your output file. Example: my-target-companies-batch-1
